items.title: `vilan fmt` reflows a file's comments only inside its project: the same file copied alone outside a project (no vilan.toml beside it) reflows nothing, so an fmt census of a single file is not the census of that file in its tree
items.discussion: lane parser-56 (post-Order 55); a scratch copy of std/src/image.vl formatted by the lane's binary reflowed nothing, while `vilan fmt --check .` in the repo named the same file (E352's comment reflow, 13 lines); the lane had to copy kolt's whole tree for E354's census
items.body: Either the reflow reads a project setting (a width, the E352 rule's gate) that a lone file lacks, or the lone-file path skips the comment pass. Rec: find which (a lone file should format exactly as it does in its tree - the formatter's rules are the file's, not the project's), pin `fmt` of a lone file against the same file under a vilan.toml, and say in docs/appendix/cli.md what a project changes about fmt, if anything. Sizing XS-S.

items.title: `edit_replay_differential::the_corpus_as_modules_answers_what_a_clean_analysis_answers` runs 724-900 s under concurrent lanes and sits at nextest's 900 s cap: every loaded full suite times it out once (m186 and parser-56 both; it passes alone in 724-818 s)
items.kind: tooling (suite; a slow test at its timeout)
items.discussion: two lanes on 2026-11-02 at load 22-31: `1 timed out` with that test the only red, green alone (724 s, 818 s); the suite's `Summary` line otherwise 11,116-11,127 passed
items.body: The test runs the whole corpus as modules through the edit-replay differential in one process - a 12-minute single test is the suite's long pole and a false red under load. Rec: split it per corpus program (one test per fixture, as `native_differential` is per program) so nextest spreads it and a timeout names a program; or raise its slot in .config/nextest.toml with a `slow-timeout` override for that binary and say why. Sizing S.
